lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×10

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: This is a present from my father.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I heard you came to save me at his behest.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Thank you.
Cervan appears to be gathering his thoughts.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I still remember what you told me.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: "If you have a shred of dignity, you'll take responsibility for your own actions."

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: After returning home, those words kept running through my mind.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I can't seem to get them out of my head.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If I keep treading the path I'm on,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I know my sins will eventually catch up to me.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Hence, I decided to turn myself in the next day,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: but I was released after just 24 hours.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I found out later that

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: the Chief was an old friend of my father.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: For fear of offending him,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: the Chief pulled some strings and had me exonerated.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: As I walked out of my cell, it was as if I had died and been reborn.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: From now on, I want nothing to do with what happens on the surface.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: It's a treacherous place,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and the charlatans who want things from it are even more insidious.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I realize that now.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I'm wiser than I was before.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: It has been an honor knowing you, but

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: let this be the last time we see each other.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: You go live the life you're meant to live,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and I'll do the same.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Stay safe out there,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}
